dj.line: Eight million three hundred eighty-eight thousand six hundred eight on the fee dial — that's the house's little flag that says the rake can be moved while your chips are still on the felt. A dealer who can rewrite the odds mid-hand isn't running a game, he's running you — so tell me, do you know which way his hand moves when the pot gets heavy?
